review_cost.rationale: Approve after one small round: guard the debounce race, add error.tsx, and collapse the three duplications. Nothing needs structural rework.

findings.issue: Debounced router.replace responses can resolve out of order; the 'sync from URL' effect then sees a mismatch against lastPushed and resets the input to the stale query, visibly clobbering what the user typed.
findings.suggestion: Track a monotonically increasing request id and ignore prop updates that correspond to an already-superseded navigation (or compare against the URL the router reports via useSearchParams).

findings.issue: Same unguarded replace pattern: fast game switching can briefly render the wrong game's move tables.
findings.suggestion: Reuse the same stale-response guard as the filters fix.

findings.issue: No error boundary anywhere in the tree; lib/api.ts:48 throws on any non-404 API failure, so users get Next's unstyled default error page.
findings.suggestion: Add an app/error.tsx (client component) with a 'Something went wrong' message and retry, matching the app's design.

findings.issue: loadTeam duplicates the species → default variety → pokemon loading sequence already in pokemon/[name]/page.tsx loadSpecies; the two copies can drift (they already differ in null-handling).
findings.suggestion: Move a loadSpeciesWithDefault(name): Promise<{species, pokemon} | null> into lib/api.ts (wrap it in React cache() at the call sites) and use it from both pages.

findings.issue: pageHref and filters.tsx href are two hand-maintained builders of the same q/type/generation query string.
findings.suggestion: Export one buildFilterQuery(values, page?) helper (e.g. from filters.tsx or lib) used by both the pagination links and the form navigation.

findings.issue: Bespoke concurrency limiter (queue + shift + active counter) is ~15 lines of scheduling machinery unique to this app, sitting next to an also-custom TTL/LRU cache.
findings.suggestion: Keep it (it prevents socket blowout when movesFor fans out to 100+ move fetches), but add a one-line comment stating that purpose; alternatively chunk the Promise.all in movesFor and delete the queue.

findings.issue: Team page re-creates PokemonCardList's <ul className="card-grid"> inline to add the remove button, duplicating the shared list markup and class names.
findings.suggestion: Give PokemonCardList an optional per-item render slot (children after the card), or a variant that renders the button.

findings.issue: members.length is shown as '<n> of 6' while the cookie may legitimately contain 6 entries of which some fail to load; the displayed count silently diverges from the stored team.
findings.suggestion: Either render the failed species names as inert placeholders, or fall back to team.length in the count text and note the discrepancy — either is fine, just make it deliberate.

summary: A genuinely well-made Next 16 App Router app: correct use of the current async APIs, `connection()` for request-time data, React cache for metadata dedup, and a clean server/client boundary for the team feature. The merge-blocking items are minor: one out-of-order-navigation race in the two URL-syncing client components, a missing error boundary, and three small duplications that a maintainer would otherwise re-derive. I'd approve after one focused round of nits.
